action_instruction: Waiting for the offers display to remain settled with the unavailable offer visible
intent: PRIMARY: confirm the offers display remains settled with the unavailable Demo Mobile Mechanics offer visible
rationale: The display already shows an unavailable offer with a 20-minute estimate and an ineligible label.

action_instruction: Checking whether the unavailable offer is present
intent: whether the offer that is unavailable now with a known arrival estimate within {{global.max_arrival_time}} is present (in the quoted offers list)

action_params.condition: The offer that is unavailable now with a known arrival estimate within {{global.max_arrival_time}} remains visible.
action_params.query: whether the offer that is unavailable now with a known arrival estimate within {{global.max_arrival_time}} is present (in the quoted offers list)
action_params.code_js: /Availability unknown, so it can't be booked/.test(el(24).innerText) && /20 min/.test(el(24).innerText)

action_instruction: Checking whether the unavailable offer has an ineligible label
intent: whether an ineligible label on the offer that is unavailable now with a known arrival estimate within {{global.max_arrival_time}} is present (on the Demo Mobile Mechanics entry in the offers ranking)

action_params.condition: The offer that is unavailable now with a known arrival estimate within {{global.max_arrival_time}} is labeled ineligible.
action_params.query: whether an ineligible label on the offer that is unavailable now with a known arrival estimate within {{global.max_arrival_time}} is present (on the Demo Mobile Mechanics entry in the offers ranking)

assertion_tree.description: The offer that is unavailable now with a known arrival estimate within {{global.max_arrival_time}} remains visible and is labeled ineligible.

sub_results.description: The offer that is unavailable now with a known arrival estimate within {{global.max_arrival_time}} remains visible.
The offer that is unavailable now with a known arrival estimate within {{global.max_arrival_time}} is labeled ineligible.

assertion_tree.verification: The identified unavailable offer remains visible in the offers display and has an ineligible label.
